## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Portuguese-language game, “Ninja Shadow – O Guerreiro das Sombras,” with sword combat, teleportation, enemies, health, coins, Japanese scenery, a final boss, and movement/jump controls.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game without clarification questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support keyboard and touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML canvas platform game with custom-drawn visuals and no game engine.
- Controls: A/D or arrows to move, Space/W/Up to jump, J/Z to attack, K/X to teleport; touch buttons are also provided.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`, including Japanese-inspired scenery, coins, ninja/oni enemies, health display, teleport, sword combat, boss fight, pause/restart, and mobile controls.
- Verified script syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Chromium and inspected desktop and mobile screenshots.
- Added a data favicon to avoid the browser’s missing-favicon request.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally recheck the final mobile layout after the latest responsive CSS adjustment.
2. Run `git status --short` and report the uncommitted changes; do not overwrite existing user files.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/ninja.jpg`: initial desktop screenshot.
- `screenshots/ninja-playing.jpg`: desktop gameplay screenshot.
- `screenshots/ninja-mobile-final.jpg`: latest mobile screenshot, captured after responsive CSS changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright CLI initially failed to find its bundled Chromium; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002 --browser chrome --headed` succeeded using installed Chrome.
